findings: Original embedding code uses CUDA/FP16 and FastReID; it is not a drop-in replacement for supervision.Detections.
No ONNX embedding path is present in the inspected embedding modules.
The standard embedding path selects MOT17/MOT20-specific weights; another dataset requires an explicit model choice.
The embedding cache checks row count on a tag hit, not exact source boxes: our adapter must include source/model/preprocessing/box hashes.
The original implementation was documented for Python 3.8/Ubuntu 18.04. Current local CUDA works; an earlier project note about unavailable CUDA no longer describes this environment.
decision: Separate ReID integration and verified weights are needed. This phase measures the motion backends only; no Deep OC-SORT accuracy claim.
